Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vinton Persian Runner Rug, 2' 3" x 7' 6", Rust Multi
Colors: Teal
Materials: stone
100% Wool Imported An antique-inspired floral design in an ornamental color palette of red, blue, turquoise, and orange on a denim blue field gives this rug an exceptional look. Each rug is hand tufted for easy care, heavy wear and an unbeatable texture. 4' x 6' Hand tufted from pure wool Made in India Medium pile height makes it durable and easy to vacuum Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
